# SmileCraft Dental Studio

> Specialist dental clinic in Andheri West, Mumbai. MDS endodontist and implantologist, transparent ₹ pricing, WhatsApp booking, same-week appointments.

This is a demonstration website built for a client pitch. Clinic name, doctors and reviews are sample data.

## Clinic facts (demo)
- Address: 302, Pearl Heights, Veera Desai Road, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053
- Hours: Mon to Sat 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Sunday by appointment
- Phone: +91 98765 43210 · WhatsApp: +91 98765 43210
- Rating: 4.9 across 312 Google reviews (sample data)
- Doctors: Dr. Ananya Sharma (MDS, Endodontics), Dr. Rohan Mehta (MDS, Prosthodontics & Implantology)

## Services and typical prices (₹, demo)
- Checkup & consultation: 500 (adjusted against treatment)
- Scaling & cleaning: 1,500 to 4,000
- Root canal (per tooth): 4,000 to 9,000
- Crowns & bridges (per unit, zirconia): 6,000 to 14,000
- Dental implant with crown: 28,000 to 45,000
- Braces / aligners (full case): 35,000 to 1,20,000
- Teeth whitening: 8,000 to 15,000
- Kids' dentistry: from 800
- Wisdom tooth extraction: 3,500 to 12,000
